scenario: E2E-38 Repository Q&A: fact recall and grounding/unsupported-claim diagnostics

evidence_classes.judge: FIXTURE judge votes through the real judge services (build_packet / parse_vote / aggregate) with rubric qa-entailment-rubric-v1 and panel qa-entailment-panel-v1; the panel is unprovisioned and no live judge call is made or claimed
evidence_classes.task: admitted authored fixture pack taskpacks/qa/py-configkit-qa-v1 (family repo_qa, methodology_label inspired, stratum deepcodebench-inspired)
evidence_classes.execution: local development run; pure contracts and grading plus the strict task-package import pipeline

e2e_38_qa_cases.case: fact recall over atomic facts via three-vote entailment, paraphrases accepted
e2e_38_qa_cases.observed: Reference (exact wording) and alternative (accepted paraphrase wording) answers over the admitted cross-file fixture both grade 100.000000 fact recall; credits are the mean of three 0/1 entailment votes aggregated by the real judge services.

e2e_38_qa_cases.case: missing facts zero, repeated facts no credit, empty answer recall zero
e2e_38_qa_cases.observed: One expressed fact of weight 1 of 3 = 33.333333; a triple-asserted fact keeps one credit (repeated fixture grade equals reference grade 100.000000); the empty answer grades 0.000000 recall with undefined claim precision.

e2e_38_qa_cases.case: exact factual contradictions never count as expressed facts
e2e_38_qa_cases.observed: A contradicting claim forces zero fact credit even under unanimous 1.0 votes (contradiction-v1 deterministic check); the admitted contradiction fixture reports contradicted claims >= 1 and recall != 100.

e2e_38_qa_cases.case: wrong citations are invalid and undercut grounding without touching fact recall
e2e_38_qa_cases.observed: The wrong-citation fixture's 5 citations are all flagged by validate_citations (path/span/digest against the pinned snapshot) and grounding is 0.000000 while fact recall stays 100.000000 - the diagnostics are separately named, never folded into recall.

e2e_38_qa_cases.case: incomplete verification is unknown, not zero
e2e_38_qa_cases.observed: With no fact/claim judgments recorded: fact_recall None with status incomplete, unsupported_claims None, unsupported_rate None, grounding None, and named incomplete_verifications entries - never a silent zero.

e2e_38_qa_cases.case: native aggregation preserved separately from entailment aggregation
e2e_38_qa_cases.observed: A semantic paraphrase outside the accepted list grades entailment recall 33.333333 while the preserved native presence aggregation records 0.000000 - both retained in QaMetrics as separate fields.

e2e_38_qa_cases.case: six code dimensions N/A; prose receives no invented security/runtime/idiom scores
e2e_38_qa_cases.observed: QaMetrics.code_dimensions is always not_applicable and the metrics field set contains no security/runtime/idiom/robustness/efficiency score of any kind.

e2e_38_qa_cases.case: execution disabled for the Q&A protocol (read/search-only)
e2e_38_qa_cases.observed: repo-qa-v1 allows list_files/read_file/search only; apply_patch and run_command are refused by validate_qa_protocol_tools (editing disabled at the contract level).

adversarial_citation_judge_fixtures.observed: A 0.500000 vote passes the judge layer (declared anchor) but the frozen entailment conversion raises 'entailment votes are 0/1' - no silent rounding.

adversarial_citation_judge_fixtures.case: entailment packet is fixed and blinded
adversarial_citation_judge_fixtures.observed: The packet carries the stated fact and candidate text only: item_ids ('entailment',), no withheld values, no oracle weight or identity in the rendered packet.

adversarial_citation_judge_fixtures.case: envelope ambiguity and malformed submissions refused
adversarial_citation_judge_fixtures.observed: Malformed JSON, ambiguous multi-fence envelopes, extra envelope keys, foreign citation digests and claims that do not quote the answer are all refused - never repaired and never chosen between.

adversarial_citation_judge_fixtures.case: citations bind to the pinned base snapshot
adversarial_citation_judge_fixtures.observed: Foreign digests, absent paths and out-of-bounds spans are each flagged against the pinned snapshot.
